name: Convex-Geometry Ideals Are Partial Cubes
scope: Finite one-inclusion graphs, up to signed-coordinate equivalence and suppression of constants.
statement: Every convex-geometry ideal graph is a partial cube.
proof: Every member of $\mathsf{Icg}$ is a pc-minor of a learning-space graph. Learning-space graphs are partial cubes, and projections and conditionings preserve the partial-cube property.
